movies.title: The Lion King
clues: This movie is set among the animals of the African savanna.
The main character is a lion cub who runs away after a tragedy.
His uncle wants the throne for himself and blames the cub for their father's death.
The cub grows up with a warthog and a meerkat who teach him 'no worries' as a way of life.

movies.title: Frozen
clues: Two royal sisters are at the heart of this snowy story.
One sister has a magical power she struggles to control.
She accidentally plunges her kingdom into an eternal winter.
Her sister sets off with a mountain man, his reindeer, and a talking snowman to bring her home.

movies.title: Aladdin
clues: This story is set in a fictional Middle Eastern city.
A street urchin finds a magical object hidden in a cave of wonders.
Inside is a being who can grant three wishes.
The hero uses a wish to disguise himself as a prince to court a princess.

movies.title: Beauty and the Beast
clues: A young woman in a French village loves to read.
Her father is imprisoned in an enchanted castle.
She trades places with him and meets the castle's cursed owner.
The household staff have been turned into talking objects, including a candlestick and a teapot.

movies.title: The Little Mermaid
clues: The main character lives under the sea and longs for the world above.
She makes a dangerous deal with a sea witch to become human.
She trades her voice for a pair of legs.
She has three days to get a prince to fall in love with her, or she belongs to the witch.

movies.title: Moana
clues: The main character is the daughter of a chief on a Polynesian island.
She sets sail across the ocean against her father's wishes.
She's searching for a legendary demigod to help restore a stolen heart.
Her companion on the journey is a shape-shifting figure named Maui.

movies.title: Toy Story
clues: This was the first entirely computer-animated feature film.
The main characters are toys that come to life when humans aren't looking.
A cowboy doll is the favorite toy of a boy named Andy.
A new spaceman action figure arrives and doesn't realize he's actually a toy.

movies.title: Finding Nemo
clues: This movie takes place mostly underwater.
A young clownfish is captured by a diver and taken far from home.
His anxious father sets out across the ocean to find him.
Along the way he's helped by a friendly blue tang fish with short-term memory loss.

movies.title: Mulan
clues: This story is set in ancient China during a war.
The main character disguises herself as a man to take her father's place in the army.
A small dragon named Mushu becomes her guardian and companion.
She ultimately saves the emperor and earns the respect of her whole country.

movies.title: Tangled
clues: This story is loosely based on the fairy tale 'Rapunzel.'
The main character has been locked in a tower her whole life by a woman posing as her mother.
Her extraordinarily long hair has magical healing powers.
A charming thief climbs into her tower and becomes her guide to the outside world.

movies.title: Cinderella
clues: The main character is forced into servitude by her stepmother and stepsisters.
A fairy godmother helps her attend a royal ball.
Her magical transportation and gown will disappear at the stroke of midnight.
She leaves behind a glass slipper that a prince uses to track her down.

movies.title: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
clues: This was Disney's first full-length animated feature film.
A jealous queen wants the main character gone because she's 'the fairest of them all.'
The heroine finds refuge in a cottage in the woods with seven small housemates.
She falls into a deep sleep after biting a poisoned apple.

movies.title: Sleeping Beauty
clues: A princess is cursed by an evil fairy at her christening.
The curse says she'll prick her finger on a spinning wheel and fall into a deep sleep.
Three good fairies raise her in secret to try to protect her.
Only true love's kiss from a prince can break the spell.

movies.title: The Jungle Book
clues: This story follows a boy raised by wolves in the jungle.
A panther and a laid-back bear look out for him.
A tiger named Shere Khan wants him gone from the jungle.
The boy eventually must decide whether to stay in the jungle or join the 'man village.'

movies.title: Hercules
clues: This movie is based on Greek mythology.
The main character is the son of Zeus, stripped of his godly powers as a baby.
He trains with a satyr to become a hero and earn his place on Mount Olympus.
The villain is the ruler of the underworld, voiced with fiery flair.

movies.title: Pocahontas
clues: This story is set in Virginia in the early 1600s.
The main character is the daughter of a Powhatan chief.
She befriends an English settler who arrives with a group of colonists.
A talking tree named Grandmother Willow gives her guidance.

movies.title: Up
clues: The main character is an elderly widower who was once an adventurer.
He ties thousands of balloons to his house to fly it to South America.
A young wilderness scout accidentally stows away on the journey.
They meet a talking dog and a rare, giant bird along the way.

movies.title: Ratatouille
clues: The main character dreams of becoming a chef in Paris.
There's just one problem: he's a rat.
He secretly controls a clumsy kitchen worker by tugging his hair to cook.
A feared food critic ultimately gives his cooking a rave review.

movies.title: Encanto
clues: This story follows a large family living in a magical house in Colombia.
Every child in the family is granted a magical gift, except one.
The magic of their house begins to crack and crumble.
The gift-less family member turns out to be the key to saving the family's magic.

movies.title: Zootopia
clues: This movie is set entirely in a city inhabited by anthropomorphic animals.
The main character is the city's first rabbit police officer.
She teams up with a sly fox con artist to solve a missing persons case.
Together they uncover a conspiracy involving predator animals 'going savage.'

movies.title: Pinocchio
clues: A woodcarver's newest creation is granted the gift of life by a wishing star.
A cricket is assigned to serve as the title character's conscience.
A fox and a cat lure him toward a stage show instead of school.
His nose grows whenever he tells a lie, and he's briefly transformed on an island where misbehaving boys turn into donkeys.

movies.title: Bambi
clues: This film follows the changing seasons in a forest from a young animal's birth.
The main character is a prince of the forest, heir to the Great Prince.
A rabbit and a skunk are his closest childhood friends.
A gunshot during hunting season leaves him orphaned, and he later must save the woodland creatures from a raging fire.

movies.title: Dumbo
clues: The main character is a circus baby delivered by a stork to the wrong mother.
He is mocked for his unusually large ears.
A group of crows and a mouse convince him he can use a 'magic feather' to fly.
His mother is chained up and locked away after trying to protect him from cruel onlookers.

movies.title: Alice in Wonderland
clues: The main character follows a waistcoat-wearing creature down a hole.
She shrinks and grows repeatedly after eating and drinking strange things.
A grinning feline can vanish, leaving only its smile behind.
A tyrannical queen obsessed with playing card soldiers keeps demanding beheadings.

movies.title: Peter Pan
clues: Three siblings in London are visited one night by a boy who can fly.
Fairy dust and happy thoughts let the children soar out their bedroom window.
They travel to an island where lost boys never grow up.
A hook-handed pirate captain is forever fleeing a crocodile that once ate his hand, along with his pocket watch.

movies.title: Lady and the Tramp
clues: This love story unfolds between two dogs of very different backgrounds.
One is a pampered house pet; the other is a streetwise stray.
A jealous pair of Siamese cats causes chaos for the family's new baby.
The two leads share a famous spaghetti dinner behind an Italian restaurant.

movies.title: 101 Dalmatians
clues: Two dog owners fall in love because of their pets in London.
The pets' family soon includes a litter of spotted puppies.
A fur-obsessed fashion villainess wants the puppies for a coat.
Her bumbling henchmen fail to stop a rescue involving dozens more stolen puppies hidden on a farm.

movies.title: The Sword in the Stone
clues: This story is loosely based on Arthurian legend.
An orphaned squire boy is secretly destined for greatness.
A wizard tutors him by transforming both of them into different animals.
He proves his destiny by pulling a legendary sword from an anvil in a churchyard stone.

movies.title: Robin Hood
clues: This retelling of a classic English legend casts every character as an animal.
The hero is a sly fox who steals from the rich to give to the poor.
A greedy lion sits on a stolen throne while his brother, the rightful king, is away.
An archery contest turns out to be a trap set by the villain to capture the hero.

movies.title: The Rescuers
clues: Two mice belong to a rescue organization based under the United Nations.
They're sent to help an orphan girl who sent a message in a bottle.
A one-eyed cat named Brutus works for the film's villain.
The villain forces the girl into tight caves to retrieve a giant diamond from a pirate's skull-shaped cave.

movies.title: The Fox and the Hound
clues: Two young animals become best friends despite what they're 'supposed' to be.
One is raised as an orphaned pet; the other lives with a hunter next door.
As they grow up, their owners expect them to become natural enemies.
A hunting dog and a fox must set aside instinct to save each other from a raging bear.

movies.title: The Black Cauldron
clues: This darker fantasy is based on a series of Welsh-inspired fantasy novels.
An assistant pig-keeper discovers his pig has the power to see the future.
A skeletal tyrant known as the Horned King seeks an ancient magical cauldron.
That cauldron can raise an unstoppable army of the undead if he obtains it.

movies.title: The Great Mouse Detective
clues: This mystery stars a rodent detective living beneath a famous London address.
He's modeled closely on a very famous human detective who lives upstairs.
A kidnapped toymaker mouse and his daughter set the plot in motion.
The villain is a fat, sinister rat who serves as this detective's arch-nemesis.

movies.title: Oliver & Company
clues: This story loosely reimagines a classic Dickens orphan tale with animals in New York City.
The main character is a kitten who falls in with a gang of streetwise dogs.
The gang's leader is a scrappy Jack Russell terrier who talks like a con artist.
A loan shark's henchdogs chase the gang through the city in a wild scooter pursuit.

movies.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
clues: The main character has lived his whole life hidden away in a cathedral bell tower.
Three animated gargoyles are his only friends and confidants.
A powerful judge is obsessed with a Romani woman who shows the hero kindness.
A citywide 'Feast of Fools' festival leads to the hero being publicly humiliated.

movies.title: The Emperor's New Groove
clues: A spoiled young emperor is turned into an animal by his own scheming advisor.
A poisoned drink was supposed to kill him but had a different side effect.
He's forced to rely on a humble llama herder he once treated terribly.
The villain's none-too-bright henchman keeps pulling the wrong lever.

movies.title: Atlantis: The Lost Empire
clues: A young linguist and museum worker joins an expedition few believe is real.
The expedition is searching for a legendary sunken civilization.
The city they find is protected by glowing blue crystal technology.
The expedition's funder turns out to be after that crystal power for himself.

movies.title: Lilo & Stitch
clues: A lonely Hawaiian girl adopts what she believes is an unusual dog from a shelter.
Her new pet is actually an illegal genetic experiment created for destruction.
Two bumbling aliens are sent to recapture him before he causes harm.
The girl teaches him that 'ohana' means family, and family means no one gets left behind.

movies.title: Treasure Planet
clues: This sci-fi retelling reimagines a classic pirate adventure novel in outer space.
A teenage boy discovers a map leading to a legendary treasure among the stars.
He sets sail on a solar-powered galleon crewed by a mix of aliens.
The ship's cook turns out to be a cyborg pirate secretly plotting a mutiny.

movies.title: Brother Bear
clues: An Inuit-inspired young hunter seeks revenge against a bear for his brother's death.
Spirits transform him into the very animal he was hunting as punishment.
He must travel to a mountain where lights touch the earth to become human again.
Along the way an orphaned bear cub mistakes him for family and won't leave his side.

movies.title: Home on the Range
clues: Three dairy cows on a Western farm learn their home is about to be foreclosed.
They set off to catch a notorious cattle rustler for the reward money.
The wanted outlaw can hypnotize animals into joining his herd of stolen cattle.
A yodeling one-eyed cow leads the trio's bounty-hunting scheme.

movies.title: Chicken Little
clues: A small-town chicken becomes a laughingstock after a false alarm about the sky falling.
A year later, something really does fall from the sky into his backyard.
It turns out to be part of an actual alien invasion ship.
He and his misfit friends must warn a town that no longer trusts a word he says.

movies.title: Meet the Robinsons
clues: A brilliant orphan boy invents a memory-scanning machine for a school science fair.
A mysterious boy claiming to be from the future warns him about a 'bowler hat guy.'
He travels forward in time and is adopted into an eccentric, chaotic family.
The film's motto, repeated throughout, is 'keep moving forward.'

movies.title: Bolt
clues: The main character is a TV star dog who believes his superpowers are real.
He's accidentally shipped across the country away from the studio set.
He teams up with a cynical alley cat and an obsessed hamster in a plastic ball.
He must learn that being an ordinary dog can still mean being a hero.

movies.title: Wreck-It Ralph
clues: The main character is the villain of his own 1980s-style arcade game.
Tired of being unappreciated, he sneaks into other games to earn a hero's medal.
He ends up in a candy-themed go-kart racing game run by a sugary tyrant.
He befriends a glitchy racer who isn't supposed to exist in that game at all.

movies.title: Big Hero 6
clues: A young robotics prodigy lives in a fictional city blending San Francisco and Tokyo.
His brother built a soft, inflatable healthcare companion robot before the story begins.
A tragic fire prompts the boy to reprogram that robot for crime-fighting.
He assembles a team of his brother's friends, each armed with their own tech-based gear.

movies.title: Raya and the Last Dragon
clues: A fantasy land once thrived until it was overrun by soul-stealing creatures called the Druun.
The land had been divided into five rival, animal-named nations.
A warrior princess sets out to reassemble a shattered magical gem.
She needs the help of the last known dragon to save her petrified father.

movies.title: Wish
clues: A young woman lives in a kingdom where people surrender their wishes to their ruler.
Most of those people never get their wishes granted at all.
She befriends a small ball of star-stuff that falls from the night sky.
She turns against the very king she once admired to reclaim everyone's stolen wishes.

movies.title: Strange World
clues: Three generations of one family of explorers don't see eye to eye.
Their remote homeland relies entirely on one glowing plant for power.
They descend beneath their world to find out why that plant is dying.
They discover their entire world is something far stranger than a planet.

movies.title: A Bug's Life
clues: This was the second entirely computer-animated feature ever released.
An ant colony must gather food each year to pay off a gang of grasshoppers.
One inventive but accident-prone ant loses the tribute and is banished.
He returns with a troupe of out-of-work circus bugs, mistaken for real warriors.

movies.title: Monsters, Inc.
clues: This company generates power by scaring human children at night.
Its top scarer is a huge, furry, blue-and-purple monster.
A door-related accident lets a little human girl loose in the monster world.
The company discovers laughter produces even more energy than screams ever did.

movies.title: Cars
clues: Every character in this world is a living vehicle instead of a person.
A hotshot rookie race car gets stranded in a forgotten town along an old highway.
The town was bypassed decades earlier when a new interstate was built nearby.
A rusty tow truck becomes his best friend despite a rocky first meeting.

movies.title: WALL-E
clues: The main character is a trash-compacting robot left alone on Earth for centuries.
Humanity fled the planet generations earlier aboard a massive space cruise liner.
A sleek white probe robot arrives searching for proof that plant life has returned.
He follows her back into space, risking everything to save one small plant.

movies.title: The Incredibles
clues: A family of superheroes is forced to live disguised as an ordinary suburban household.
Superheroes had been legally banned years earlier after one too many lawsuits.
The father secretly moonlights on hero missions his wife doesn't know about.
A former childhood fan-turned-villain lures him into a trap on a remote island.

movies.title: Brave
clues: A Scottish princess would rather shoot arrows than follow royal tradition.
Her mother wants her to marry a suitor chosen from the kingdom's rival clans.
A witch's spell meant to change her mother's mind goes horribly wrong instead.
Her mother is transformed into a bear, and the spell must be undone before it's permanent.

movies.title: Inside Out
clues: This story takes place mostly inside the mind of an 11-year-old girl.
Five emotions take turns operating the control panel of her brain.
One emotion, usually in charge, insists on staying relentlessly positive.
A move to a new city throws the whole emotional headquarters into chaos when core memories go missing.

movies.title: Coco
clues: A boy from a family that has banned music for generations dreams of being a musician.
He's magically transported to a vibrant land of the dead during a holiday of remembrance.
He needs a long-dead relative's blessing before sunrise or he'll be trapped there.
He idolizes a famous, long-deceased singer who may not be who he seems.

movies.title: Luca
clues: This story is set in a sun-soaked town on the Italian Riviera.
The main character is secretly a sea monster who can pass as human on land.
He and a new friend dream of winning a local town race for a prize scooter.
Being caught in the rain risks exposing what he really is to the whole town.

movies.title: Turning Red
clues: A confident 13-year-old in Toronto keeps a huge secret from her overprotective mother.
Strong emotions cause her to transform into a giant red panda.
Her family has passed this ability down through generations of women.
She must choose whether to seal the panda away forever during a rare red moon ritual.

movies.title: Soul
clues: A middle school band teacher finally gets his big break as a jazz pianist.
An accident sends his soul toward the afterlife before he can play the gig.
He escapes into a realm where new souls develop their personalities before being born.
He's mistaken for a mentor to a soul who has no interest in life on Earth at all.

movies.title: Onward
clues: Two elf brothers live in a suburban fantasy world that has forgotten most of its magic.
A birthday spell is meant to briefly bring their late father back to life.
The spell only succeeds in restoring the bottom half of him.
The brothers set off on a quest before the magic runs out at sunset the next day.

movies.title: The Good Dinosaur
clues: This story imagines what if the asteroid that ended the dinosaurs had missed Earth.
A young dinosaur is separated from his family after a river accident.
A feral human boy becomes his unlikely companion on the journey home.
He must overcome his fears to survive alongside his newfound friend in the wild.
